claimed_benefit: 87.6% lower median elapsed time in the supplied warm batch workload (2156.4 to 267.8 ms); exact output preserved.
limits: Three local warm-batch trials on Bun 1.3.5 / Windows; no population or cold-start speed claim.
Unused partial sources are now loaded only when invoked; unreadable unused files no longer fail unrelated renders. Used-source errors still propagate.
Cache bounded to 256 entries and 4 million source characters; compilation memory itself is not directly measured.
No agents, model downstream evaluation, network, installs, Git or publication; no claim about prompt quality or SkillForge comparative effectiveness.
Concurrent file mutation during a synchronous render is not an atomic snapshot, as in the baseline.
